messages:
olivia: alert — hosted-api (us-east) p99 shot up ~12:03 UTC, p95 also elevated. graphs show queue depth spike and a bunch of kernel-fallback events. anyone free to triage?
jun: on it. quick snapshot: runtime queue_depth for /v1/generate jumped from avg 18 -> ~120 at 12:02. kernel_selection.log shows many `fallback_kernel` picks starting 11:59.
deploy-bot: rolled out runtime-heuristics v2.4.1 to us-east at 11:58 UTC by ci/CD (deploy-789).
sam: looks like the new kernel heuristic is mispredicting for longer seqs. also kvcache hitrate for high-volume tenants dropped: `hitrate=0.78 -> 0.35` for tenant alpha between 11:57-12:05.
rachel: uploading a quick flamegraph and alloc profile: <s3://redwood-artifacts/us-east/perf/1977777777/flame.svg>. flame shows hot path in `select_kernel()` and `batch_coordinator.wait_for_batch()` spinning.
tony: rate limiter logs show global QPS spiked 3x concurrently. batching queue hit `max_queue_depth` and many requests were flushed as tiny batches -> heavy kernel overhead.
maria: if kernel policy is the culprit i can toggle back to legacy. do we need a service restart?
jun: no restart — the policy is hot-config. patch: `curl -XPOST /admin/config -d '{"runtime.kernel_policy":"legacy"}'` or set via console. also suggest lowering `max_batch_size` temporarily.
olivia: mitigation plan applied: set `runtime.kernel_policy=legacy` in us-east at 12:12; reduced `max_batch_size` 64->48; bumped prefix KV cache TTL to reduce thrash. please watch metrics.
deploy-bot: config change applied to runtime-1..4 in us-east at 12:12 UTC.
sam: quick post-mitigation numbers: p99 back down ~300ms (was 1.2s), p95 near baseline. queue depth returning to normal. good short-term win.
olivia: notes for follow-up: 1) collect full profiles across runtime nodes (sam), 2) add canary gating for kernel heuristic rollouts (rachel + infra), 3) investigate noisy tenant "alpha" request pattern that exposed batching inefficiency (tony), 4) tune batching thresholds and add alerts for sudden kvcache hitrate drops (maria).
rachel: uploading full profiles to /artifacts/1977777777/profiles.tar.gz and adding flamegraph links to the incident ticket.
olivia: great work — we'll draft a short postmortem + mitigation checklist. closing for now unless regressions reappear. :thumbsup:
